methodology: Manually verified public-source records. Nation-specific organizations and tribal-council affiliations are distinct; affiliation is not treated as direct ownership. Unknown values remain null.

organizations.name: Peter Ballantyne Group of Companies
organizations.description: For-profit business development entity that manages Peter Ballantyne Cree Nation-wide corporate business investments.
organizations.mandate: Hold and manage PBCN-owned corporate business investments and pursue new investment opportunities.

organizations.name: Kitsaki Management Limited Partnership
organizations.description: Manages the economic development activities of Lac La Ronge Indian Band and a diversified investment portfolio.
organizations.mandate: Build and invest in businesses that benefit Lac La Ronge Indian Band and provide employment, training and contracting opportunities.

organizations.name: Des Nedhe Group
organizations.description: English River First Nation economic development organization with businesses in industrial services, retail, property and professional services.
organizations.mandate: Grow sustainable employment and business opportunities for English River First Nation members.

organizations.name: FHQ Developments
organizations.description: Investment and economic development corporation formed by the eleven member First Nations of File Hills Qu'Appelle Tribal Council and FHQTC.
organizations.mandate: Develop profitable ventures, economic opportunities, employment and livelihoods for its limited partners and citizens.

organizations.name: Meadow Lake Tribal Council Industrial Investments
organizations.legalName: Meadow Lake Tribal Council Industrial Investments
organizations.description: Indigenous-owned economic development corporation created by the nine Meadow Lake Tribal Council First Nations.
organizations.mandate: Pursue economic development in forestry, renewable energy, oil and gas, agriculture and hospitality for member Nations.

organizations.name: STC Industrial Group
organizations.description: First Nations-owned group of industrial businesses co-owned through the seven Saskatoon Tribal Council member Nations.
organizations.mandate: Create industrial business and career opportunities for STC communities.

organizations.name: Prince Albert First Nations Business Development Limited Partnership
organizations.legalName: Prince Albert First Nations Business Development Limited Partnership
organizations.description: Economic development arm of Prince Albert Grand Council, historically known as PADC.
organizations.mandate: Develop corporate ventures and employment opportunities connected to PAGC member First Nations.

organizations.name: First Alliance Companies
organizations.description: Business organization presented by Battlefords Agency Tribal Chiefs as an entity focused on Indigenous economic partnerships.
organizations.mandate: Build partnerships for Indigenous economic success.

organizations.name: TATC Development Corporation
organizations.legalName: Touchwood Agency Tribal Council Development Corporation
organizations.description: Development corporation named by the Touchwood Agency Tribal Council Economic Development service as a collaborating TATC organization.
organizations.mandate: Support economic development work connected to Touchwood Agency Tribal Council member Nations.

organizations.name: Yorkton Tribal Council Economic Development
organizations.description: Yorkton Tribal Council service area for economic development. The public source does not identify a separate investment corporation.
organizations.mandate: Support economic development and future business ventures for YTC member Nations.

organizations.name: Agency Chiefs Tribal Council Economic Development
organizations.description: Economic development activity documented through a Government of Canada agriculture and food-systems project. No separate EDC was identified in the source.
organizations.mandate: Coordinate economic ventures and capacity building for ACTC member Nations.

organizations.name: Kahkewistahaw Economic Management Corporation
organizations.description: Wholly owned economic development corporation of Kahkewistahaw First Nation.
organizations.mandate: Develop opportunities and a diversified portfolio on behalf of Kahkewistahaw First Nation.

organizations.name: Waterhen Lake First Nation Development LP
organizations.legalName: Waterhen Lake First Nation Development LP
organizations.description: Business arm created to develop, direct and oversee Waterhen Lake First Nation business interests, investments and opportunities.
organizations.mandate: Generate own-source revenue and employment through economic development projects.

organizations.name: Piapot Development Corporation
organizations.description: Development corporation referenced by Piapot First Nation's official economic development page.
organizations.mandate: Support disciplined and sustainable economic growth for Piapot First Nation.

organizations.name: Fort a la Corne Development Corporation
organizations.legalName: Fort a la Corne Development Corporation
organizations.description: Development corporation established for the benefit of the James Smith Cree Nation communities.
organizations.mandate: Promote and carry out commercial enterprise and facilitate business, service and employment opportunities.

organizations.name: White Bear Nations Development LP
organizations.description: Organization publicly listed as representing White Bear First Nations economic and community development interests.
organizations.mandate: Represent White Bear First Nations economic and community development interests.

represents economic and community development interests
